info.description: Generated from the built assemblies at this commit. Success statuses appear only where an endpoint declares them; an operation without a declared status documents its body under `default` rather than asserting a guessed 200. Permissions are published as `x-elsa-permissions`, and the providing assembly/feature as `x-elsa-assembly`/`x-elsa-feature-id` so operations can be intersected with hosts.json exactly like features and expression types.
